job.job_title: Sr. Azure Generative AI Engineer / Consultant
job.job_description:
Job Description:
Design and develop Azure-native Generative AI applications using Azure AI services.
Implement LLM-powered solutions leveraging Azure OpenAI Service.
Build Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions using Azure AI Search and vector-based search capabilities.
Develop scalable backend services and APIs using Azure App Services or related Azure compute services.
Integrate Generative AI solutions with enterprise applications and data platforms.
Optimize AI models and prompts to improve accuracy, performance, and cost efficiency.
Collaborate with data scientists, architects, and developers to deliver end-to-end AI-driven solutions.
Ensure solutions follow security, governance, and compliance standards within the Azure environment.
Monitor and maintain AI services for reliability, scalability, and performance.
Stay up to date with the latest Generative AI and Azure AI platform advancements.


Disclaimer : This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.
